rate_normalization.note: Modern coefficient conversion supplements LKH82 Gaussian-unit equations; these absolute coefficients are not printed in LKH82.

conditional_target_chain.branch_basis_case: assume Table I 0.24 is absolute emitted-photon probability p_gamma per parent decay, all relevant branches accounted, and no non-photon loss for this gamma-only case
conditional_target_chain.fE2_status: pure-E2 extraction condition, not a measured mixing fraction; M3/E4 higher multipoles are not ruled out by DeltaI=2 alone
conditional_target_chain.uncertainty_scope: Assumes printed tau and target branch errors are independent; excludes energy uncertainty because none is printed, branch covariance, unknown branch basis/ICC, fE2 uncertainty, and stopping/feeding model systematics.
conditional_target_chain.correlation_range_note: Algebraic first-order range only for rho in [-1,1] at fixed marginal tau/branch errors; not a measured confidence interval.

branch_basis_forward_cases.condition: Table I value already equals the absolute emitted-photon probability per parent decay.
F_gamma is the unknown total emitted-photon fraction of parent decays; any omitted gamma/non-gamma channel changes it.

branch_basis_forward_cases.case: true total transition branch including IC
branch_basis_forward_cases.condition: Complete pair ledger, ordinary all-shell conversion, no E0/pair for selected transition; alpha_eff not supplied.

conversion_boundary.IC: MU08 does not give an ICC input for this row; alpha_eff is not inferred from quoted B. Modern BrIcc results remain conditional and do not identify the authors' actual branch/ICC procedure.
conversion_boundary.E0: E0 cannot accompany the selected 18- -> 16- DeltaI=2 transition because E0 has L=0. The table does not establish completeness of other unobserved parent-decay channels.
conversion_boundary.pair_creation: 757.4 keV is below the 1.022 MeV pair-creation threshold.

same_parent_dependence.assumptions: same mother-level tau and common branch chart; 401.2 treated as pure M1 per MU08 extraction assumption; 757.4 treated as pure E2; branch-specific non-photon corrections ignored only in this conditional ratio
same_parent_dependence.dependencies: The ratio shares Table I branching, transition energies, source assignment, and mode assumptions; common tau cancels. It is not independent confirmation of either absolute B or lifetime.
same_parent_dependence.reverse_B_note: Deterministic factor 37/33 applied to same conditional B; not a second measurement, and no RME phase is supplied.

normalization_error_boundary.conditional_joint_SD_implication: If (and only if) the three values were marginal SDs of one finite-variance random vector normalized sample-by-sample, sigma_a<=sigma_b+sigma_c would require 0.06<=0.04, which fails.
normalization_error_boundary.interpretation: Reject that extra joint-error model only; MU08 does not specify these parentheses as such SDs, so this does not diagnose author error or reveal actual covariance.
